instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up from a low angle. Against a backdrop of palm trees and a bright blue sky, the man in the maroon polo shirt (R1) carries the young girl in the pink tie-dye dress (R2) on his shoulders. Both the man (R1) and the young girl (R2) look toward the left with cheerful smiles. Her hands rest gently on his head as he holds her legs securely. The scene is bathed in vibrant, direct sunlight.
